programmes.d: Carla was a beautiful, budding travel influencer who vanished while on vacation in paradise...and she was never heard from again.
Cody worked at a local prison in Arizona. He had a good relationship with his girlfriend until a woman on Facebook named Paige offered to meet Cody deep in the desert alone.
A young woman studying at the University of Utah was secretly seeking "Sugar Daddies" on a dating app. She didn't find what she was seeking, instead she found a psychopath.
While Tiara's husband is away working for the US Navy she meets up with a man she connected with on Craigslist Personal Ads only to be found dead four days later.
Tim was down on his luck and by a stroke of luck he found a job with room and board online. Maybe his luck was turning? This wouldn't be the case as he was about to meet "The Craigslist Killer".
Julissa, a young woman battling sobriety and making ends meet, fell into giving sensual massages to support herself. Her last customer was an unlikely criminal known as "The Craigslist Killer."
Like most people in the 21st Century, Xixi turned to online dating to find love. Little did she know that she met her murderer online and even moved in with him.
Sarah decided to meet up with a man she had been talking to through the app Tagged. After the meet up she was nowhere to be found until her sister discovered something beyond her imaginations.
David and his wife Kim seemed to have the perfect life. However, David was keeping a big secret from everyone‚Äö which eventually lead to his murder at a popular gay hotel..
George, a popular radio newsman in New York City was brutally murdered in his apartment after he met a knife fanatic on Craigslist, and he was found butchered the next day.
Katie went on a fun date with Carl that ended with Katie carrying a very intoxicated Carl as they checked into his nearby hotel. Katie's body was later found near the hotel.
Jepsy traveled to the US from the Philippines in search of a better life. It was not long after arriving in the US did she fall in love with a man online, and then went missing.
Like many people looking for love, Adam turned to the online dateline apps. He met a young woman on Plenty Of Fish and they both decided to meet in person, but it was clear she had other motives
Cynthia, a sweet and kind young woman was manipulated and killed by Denali - a woman whom she thought was her friend.
Meredith, a successful young woman, fell in love with a man who had just joined her workplace through an online job search, but it wasn't long until Meredith was found dead.
Video gaming is a way for people to connect and have fun together online. But when things turn sour when gaming online, it can get nasty and innocent people are at risk of getting hurt.
Single Mother Ingrid met a man on OkCupid by the name of John . John and Ingrid were getting along really well and their new romance was beginning to blossom. But was John really who he said he was?
Bobbie Jo, a soon to be mother, was part of an online forum for puppy breeding and through this forum had a meetup. But after the meeting Bobbie was dead and her unborn baby was nowhere to be found.
Sydney went on a Tinder date with a girl named Audrey and never made it to work the next morning.
A gruesome Manhattan murder mystery where a Tech CEO was found dismembered in his lower east side apartment. Could the masked man on his elevator security camera be his murderer?
Grace went on a Tinder date with a man name Jesse who begged her for the date. Jesse was the last person to see Grace alive but he didn't know the CCTV cameras followed his every move.
A seriously twisted love triangle turned deadly when an innocent young man named Brian paid with his life. Was it a jealous lover or an online web of lies beyond anyone's imagination?
Carla was a beautiful, budding travel influencer who vanished while on vacation in paradise...and she was never heard from again.
Examines the triangular relationship between politicians, lawmen, and the underworld. Features the murderous Dutch Schultz and his target D.A. Thomas Dewey.
Covers the Kefauver Hearings in 1950 that were the public's first exposure to the depth and brutality of the Mafia's dealings.
Covers the infamous New York mob families from the murder of Paul Castellano outside Sparks Steak House to the new Mafia--brutal gangs from Colombia and Russia.
A probe into the justice system's failure to protect society from career criminals. Focuses on the case of Richard Allen Davis who abducted and murdered 12-year-old Polly Klaas.
Story of the Old West's most murderous villains, including the James Younger gang, the first real bank robbers in America; the Dalton Brothers; and, Butch Cassidy's Wild Bunch.
Covers the fights within unions between the Communists and the Mob, as well as the conflict between gangster Willie Bioff and Hollywood moguls.
In 1978, two siblings narrowly survive a home invasion attack and are shocked to learn that the culprit is a serial killer with a long list of victims.
When a woman goes missing after a concert, her family fears for the worst. When another girl goes missing, detectives fear that a serial killer is lurking in Charlottesville, Virginia.
A young woman is found chained to the wall of a shipping container and for detectives, it’s only the tip of the iceberg in taking down South Carolina’s very own serial killer.
For decades, detectives in Washington search for the perpetrator behind three unsolved murder cases. Finally, they can match DNA to a suspect. But 'he' doesn’t exist anymore.
From 2010-2017, Toronto’s LGBTQ+ community is terrorized by a serial killer that preys on immigrants and the vulnerable.
A young man complains to police about investigating him for three murder cases. What they don’t realize at first is they’re speaking with one of America’s youngest serial killers.
When a series of men go missing, all roads lead back to a farm in New Hampshire and one woman. What detectives find in their search of the property leaves them speechless.
When seven women disappear in 2003, investigators fear they have a serial killer within their vicinity.
Detectives in Houston, Texas search for a killer with an everyday job and a signature method. Though he evades capture for years, it’s an in-the-family atrocity that brings him to justice.
Hurricane Katrina devastated Louisiana communities in August 2005. But many bodies found in the bayou were the victims of someone much more sadistic.
A bored ex-wife and a conman begin a dangerous game where fear is the ultimate weapon, and the stakes are life or death.
After killing a pornographer exploiting underage girls, two teenage lesbian lovers flee with their family, evading police in a daring cross-country escape.
